g.text: Immediate scores stay near chance as thinking reports improve
Candidate scores ignore later answer formatting; one tied argmax each at 1.7B/4B receives no credit.
32B candidate scores were not collected: its off point is strict accuracy only. No candidate value is imputed.
Thinking-on triangles include invalid/capped outputs. Paired intervals use strict reports in both arms.
